get.description:
This sandbox's events over a WebSocket: the stored ones after `afterSeq`, then live ones, each once and in order. A plain GET is 426.

Server frames:

- `{"type": "event", "event": {...}}`, one per event, in `seq` order.
- `{"type": "live", "seq": N}`, once, when the stream turns live: every matching event up to `N` has been sent and later ones follow as they are logged.
- `{"type": "error", "code", "message"}` before the server closes the stream with 1011.

A client that reads too slowly is dropped once 1 MiB is waiting to be sent to it; shutdown closes the stream with 1001. To resume, reconnect with `afterSeq` set to the last `seq` received, or to the `live` frame's `N` when that is greater.

Scope: `read`.

parameters.name: afterSeq
parameters.description: Replay the stored events after this `seq` first; without it, only new ones.

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types, each exact or `prefix.*` for every type starting with `prefix.`; at most 32. May repeat.

101.description: Switching Protocols: the WebSocket is open.

400.description: An invalid body or query (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`) naming the first path.

401.description: A missing or invalid bearer token (`E_DENIED`).

403.description: The key lacks the scope, or a browser-originated request or foreign Host (`E_DENIED`).

404.description: No such resource, or one the key does not see.

426.description: A plain GET without a WebSocket upgrade (`E_INVALID_PARAMS`).

429.description: Too many failed authentications from this address (`E_LIMIT`); see `Retry-After`.

default.description: Any other failure; see the error codes.
